The peak limit of the upward output swing is Vcc-UCES-VE=20-1-11=8 V; the peak limit of the downward output swing is VE-UCES=11-1=10 V. The input sinusoidal signal Ui=4 V is taken as an RMS value according to the problem method, so the peak value is 4√2≈5.66 V, which is less than the upper and lower allowed peak values 8 V and 10 V, so clipping distortion will not occur.
